text: また　あえると　いいな！

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A verb plus といい says 'it would be good if', which is how you say 'I hope'. The な at the end makes it a wish said to oneself. あえると いいな = 'I hope we can meet'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing あう to あえる adds the meaning 'can'. あえる = 'can meet'.
